items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: The guy that had the group, and it was Freddie Moore; Freddie Moore, the drummer. Freddie Moore had the group in there

ctx.x: Roy Eldridge, yeah -- so you really fit in good company there. I just want to make a note of that so people will know who those guys were at that time.

And then, like the third night, that was the first time I ran in to Cozy Cole. There was a club at 142nd Street, and 7th Avenue -- oh my God, I can't remember, right down the street from the Woodside Hotel. The guy that had the group, and it was Freddie Moore; Freddie Moore, the drummer. Freddie Moore had the group in there --
